messages:
Sofia (People Ops): Quick heads-up  we need Maria's passport + original I-94 couriered to outside counsel for a PREMIUM H-1B amendment filing today. Can someone confirm pickup window and whether Maria can drop off at 1pm at reception?

Maria (New Hire): I can swing by. Do you need the physical passport or will a notarized copy do? I uploaded scans to Ripley but I still have the original with me.

Sofia (People Ops): Legal wants the physical passport when consulate paperwork may follow. Also need the original I-94 and the signed HR cover letter (link below). Notarization not required unless counsel requests later. I'll generate a prepaid DHL label. Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/hr/immigration-cover-letter.pdf

James (Recruiter): Courier cost approved up to $150 for express. I can meet Maria at reception at 12:50 and hand off. Want me to book pickup?

Maria (New Hire): 12:50 works. One more Q: should I bring my driver's license too?

Immig-Legal (bot): Checklist: for premium amendment we require: passport bio page (copy), original passport (if consulate action expected), original I-94, signed HR cover letter, fee receipt. Notarization: generally not required. See /legal/immigration/checklist.

Kyle (HR Ops): Use DHL Express Documents to our counsel (acct 54321). If they go to NYC firm, pickup window today 1:30pm-2:30pm. Maria, please leave items with reception and indicate "Immigration - Sofia". We'll reimburse courier via expense.

Sofia (People Ops): Action items: 1) James to book DHL and post tracking here; 2) Maria to drop originals at reception at ~12:50; 3) I'll email DHL label and cc counsel (Olivia). :white_check_mark:

James (Recruiter): Booked DHL pickup 1:30pm. Tracking: JDHL123456789. Pickup confirmed for reception. I'll DM Maria the printable label.

Immig-Legal (bot): Logged shipment: JDHL123456789. ETA @ counsel: 2026-03-19 09:00 ET. Filing priority: PREMIUM. Docket ref: H1B-AMEND-2026-MARIA.

Maria (New Hire): Got the label DM. I'll be at reception 12:45 with passport, I-94, and my driver's license. Thanks!

Sofia (People Ops): Thanks all. Please add courier receipt to Expensify and tag it "immigration-courier". I'll confirm when counsel uploads proof of receipt to the docket.
